Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface MessageService

All Known Implementing Classes:
MessageServiceImpl
public interface MessageService
Service interface for messaging operations. This interface defines the contract for comprehensive messaging functionality including private messages between users, conversation threads, and notification integration.

Key messaging services include:

  • Message Creation: Creating and sending messages between users
  • Conversation Management: Managing message threads and conversation history
  • Read Status Tracking: Tracking message read states and timestamps
  • Notification Integration: Automatic notification creation for new messages
  • User Communication: Secure messaging with proper authorization controls
  • Message History: Retrieving conversation history and message threads

This service provides secure internal messaging capabilities with proper authorization checks and notification integration to ensure users are promptly informed of new messages.
